rows.probe: Read the renderer of the cited commit: 89b3bc75 SSOT line 7460 (renderWallets) emits per wallet row <select name="mode">, <select name="copy_mode"> (prop/fixed), <input name="fixed_notional">, <input name="norm_base">, save/CLO/OFF/archive. Line 7463 emits the single 'No live-copy wallets configured.' <tr> when live_wallet_rows is empty. Evidence: api wallets={}.
rows.why: Empty-config observation only. With no rows the table emits the placeholder and no controls, so an absent control is indistinguishable from an absent row. The cited commit's source renders copy_mode per row, contradicting this row's defect claim. Empty-wallet absence cannot fail a configured-wallet field.

reviewer_statement: I could not disprove the card's limitation clause - it correctly says the observation does not establish configured-wallet behaviour. That admission is exactly why 14 of 15 rows cannot be FAIL. The one surviving FAIL (056) survives on source evidence the card did not use. The artifact also fails as an artifact on five independent card-level grounds: no replayable probe, wrong schema shape, wrong process binding, no content hash, and a 145-file branch delta.
